evidence.quote: Council reviewed and adopted 5-0 a high utility user application moratorium. The halt gives the city breathing room to align code and regulations on applications for projects like data centers, AI facilities, hydrogen production plants and crypto currency mining operations and similar projects. The halt is in effect for six months.
